label: Favouring determinations are realized on stand-in items
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: for every bearer b and every favouring determination of b (the real determination that a favouring of b is the profile phi), in every variation scenario s and for all candidates x, y, phi favours x over y at s exactly when a relation among items holds between b's stand-in for x and b's stand-in for y (the profile is the inverse image of an item relation under the stand-in assignment). A stand-in is the real item through which a candidate figures in b's favouring: the candidate itself if present, otherwise something else. The rationale: a real favouring relation of a real bearer has real terms even when the candidates do not exist. It does not say where the stand-ins are or what kind of item they are; the item relation and the assignment are parameters.
